full_judgment: 3. Relevant facts for the purpose of disposal of this rule in brief, are that the petitioner is the Managing Director of Oghran Properties Ltd., a land developer company, applied for installation of electricity in the premises being holding No. 385/3-A, West Rampura, Dhaka covering 0.1944 acre land of mouza Ulon ('''F) and at present West Ulon under police station Rampura district Dhaka being CS khatian No.116 corresponding to SA khatian No. 249 and 250, RS khatian No. 409 and 830 and recent City Jorip khatian No. 2379 appertaining to CS and SA plot No. 150 corresponding to RS plot No. 510 and City Jorip plot No. 4365. Said premises has been under ownership and possession of Syeda Chowdhury who purchased the same vide registered sale deed being No. 2915 of 1972. While Syeda Chowdhury was thus owning and possessing the same by mutating and recording her name in different Government authorities including Mohanagar City Jorip Khatian, she by a deed of agreement dated 17-10-2016 followed by registered Power of Attorney dated 17-10-2016 being No. 4402 handed over the said land to the petitioner for constructing multi-storied apartment building and the petitioner, after getting possession and control thereof, got a building plan approved by RAJUK for constructing 10 (ten) storied residential building and completed all formalities for construction of the said building by investing huge amount of money. In that event, the petitioner applied before respondent No. 5, the Executive Engineer, Dhaka Power Distribution Company Limited for installation of electricity in the said holding by letter dated 30-3-2017 but respondent No. 5 declined to receive the said application. Thereafter, the petitioner has come up with this writ petition and obtained the initial rule, as stated above.
